observations: Two steam irons stacked vertically, both appear to be in used condition.
Each iron has a black control panel with two orange indicator lights, a red power button, and a dial knob.
The irons have a white handle and a black base with a steam vent on top.
The irons are connected to power cords with plugs visible in photo 0.
The irons appear to be in a clean, possibly new or lightly used condition, but no signs of heavy wear.
No visible damage to the body or control panel.
The seller claims 'Uk used vaporella steam iron' and 'Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.'
